topic.source_contract: artificial-light planning, dark landscapes, ecological receptors, statutory nuisance, controls and monitoring

scope_guards: A lighting plan is not treated as installed or commissioned lighting.
Compliance with planning guidance is not treated as immunity from statutory nuisance controls.
Statutory nuisance exemptions are not treated as planning acceptability.
A dark-sky designation or dark baseline is not treated as an automatic refusal.
Generic lux values are not treated as receptor-specific compliance.
Proposed curfews and dimming are not treated as implemented controls.
A bat survey is not treated as a protected-species mitigation licence.
No score or promotion is written without exact scheme, receptors, conditions, installation, commissioning and monitoring evidence.
